# String Length

![String Length function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/string/01-longueur-chaine.svg)

[String functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Returns the number of bytes in a String, including embedded NUL bytes. UTF-8 é occupies two bytes; no Unicode character count or normalization is performed.

## Product execution profiles

The shared index declares native examples for this object; see [the examples below](length.md#examples) and [document profiles and evidence boundaries](../../reference/studio-draft-examples.md). Older binding/help statements retained below can lag those product profiles. They do not establish or deny the separately measured native profiles. An example declaration alone is not an execution result or admission of every overload.

Renvoie le nombre d’octets d’une chaîne, y compris les octets NUL internes. Le caractère é en UTF-8 occupe deux octets ; aucun comptage de caractères Unicode ni normalisation n’est effectué. [Types] Une chaîne, ou un tableau/cluster ne contenant que des chaînes, produit des longueurs en octets I32 avec les mêmes rangs et la même structure de cluster.

## Types and connection rules

String or an array/cluster containing only Strings produces I32 byte lengths with exactly the same rank and cluster structure.

- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

**Input count:** 1; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

## Examples

These are real `.frog` documents from the same index used by Studio. Backend names and expected results describe the examples; they are not execution certificates.

- [String Length — ascii](../../examples/string.length.ascii.md) — Length counts bytes, including NUL. UTF-8 é occupies two bytes; this example does not count Unicode characters. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [String Length — empty](../../examples/string.length.empty.md) — Length counts bytes, including NUL. UTF-8 é occupies two bytes; this example does not count Unicode characters. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [String Length — utf8](../../examples/string.length.utf8.md) — Length counts bytes, including NUL. UTF-8 é occupies two bytes; this example does not count Unicode characters. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [String Length — nul](../../examples/string.length.nul.md) — Length counts bytes, including NUL. UTF-8 é occupies two bytes; this example does not count Unicode characters. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [String Length preserves Cluster fields](../../examples/string.length.cluster-tree.md) — Each String leaf is replaced by its byte length. Cluster field identities and names remain in the same order, including when UTF-8 uses several bytes. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
